headline: Valeura Energy Announces Launch of Common Share Buyback Program
summary: Upstream oil and gas producer Valeura Energy launched a common share buyback program to repurchase shares on public markets, returning surplus capital to shareholders.
why: Valeura Energy is a Canadian-listed exploration and production company operating producing offshore oil assets in the Gulf of Thailand.

impacts.name: Valeura Energy
impacts.why: Share repurchases reduce outstanding float and demonstrate management confidence in corporate free cash flow.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
